name.full: HVE Squad for Copilot Cowork and Code

description.short: HVE project management and experimental Code implementation
description.full: Connects GUID-bound OneDrive or SharePoint projects to the HVE Squad Coordinator through squad_run. Presents server notices and questions, saves explicit answers, submits them through squad_respond with Squad.Run, verifies receipts, and resumes the same run. Operator approval remains separate through squad_approve with Squad.Operate. Mirrors canonical server files and maintains a stakeholder library of deliverables, pending decisions and next steps. Adds capability-tested Code implementation from versioned inputs with verified same-folder source uploads and separate evidence receipts. Missing connectors remain blockers for HVE work; no deployment or automatic cross-tab control.

agentConnectors.description: Enter through squad_run. Relay explicit same-run human answers with squad_respond; keep operator squad_approve separate. Poll existing runs, retrieve outputs with read-only squad_history, and mirror server files.
